blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. arrived in Shenzhen, China, on Wednesday afternoon ahead of the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) Economic Leaders’ Meeting. The Philippine delegation landed at Shenzhen Bao’an International Airport at 5:30 p.m. READ: Marcos faces balancing act at Apec summit in China Marcos will proceed directly to a gala dinner hosted by Chinese President Xi Jinping for visiting Asia-Pacific leaders. On Nov. 19, Thursday, Xi will personally welcome Marcos and other visiting leaders at the ceremonial opening of the Apec Economic Leaders’ Meeting.
